'''2004 European Championship Stefaan Lambrecht LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Stefaan Lambrecht]] at [[2004 European Championship]]; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by stefaan "irol" lambrecht (2004-07-21).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=33221 TRM/EBO guerilla]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040817165239/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=33221 Internet Archive]</ref>
